game_concept: A card battler set in The Kingdom – Wall Battlements, the high battlements: the squire must handle bandits while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Score Keeper: Update score, lives and ammo variables after every event while bandits close in.
theme: The Kingdom – Wall Battlements: the high battlements
core_gameplay_loop: Read the requested procedure, drag flowchart shapes into the chart, then run checks against example inputs and expected outputs.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Chain 10 consecutive correct decisions about score to power up the squire and open the granary door.
controls: Drag blocks from the tray into chart positions. Drag them back to remove them. Check chart runs the algorithm. Keyboard: [ or ] selects a block, arrows choose a position, Enter places, C checks, Escape pauses.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: CP1 Week 1: Controls and mission practice
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Score Keeper' (Week 1 slot 6), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Wall Battlements'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how score changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against bandits in Wall Battlements.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 10.
